tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250rdzogs pa chen po bka' 'dus kyi: rtsa sgrub snying po don 'dus las: dkyil 'khor 'jug pa'i snying po bzhugs: 1$0000300

bka' 'dus rtsa ba'i snying tig go ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ bla ma he ru ka la bdud:1$0000250 rdzogs pa chen po bka' 'dus kyi: rtsa sgrub snying po 'dus pa las: dkyil 'khor 'jug pa'i snying po bstan: yo byad thams cad 'du byas la: slob ma khrus bya bgegs bskrad nas: yon 'bul gsol ba 'di skad gdab: 1$0000300ho: 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po la: bying ba skyabs med rnams la skyobs: dngos grub rnam gnyis bdag 'dod pas: sta gon la ni gnas par zhu:1$0000250 de la bla mas bka' bstsal ba: 1$0000300ho: ma rig srid pa'i 'khrul 'khor 'dir: 'khor ba'i sems can snying re rje: thar pa myur du thob pa'i thabs: dngos grub sna tshogs 'thob 'gyur ba'i: gsang sngags bla med 'di la ni: skal pa med pa mi rung bas: dngos grub skal pa brtag par bya:1$0000250 nges 'byung skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ldan: slob dpon thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis: slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum sbyangs: 1$0000300hūm̐ las rdo rje sems dpa'i sku: dkar gsal rdo rje dril bu 'dzin: rgyan rdzogs pad zla'i gdan bzhugs pa'i: 1$0000250gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan: so shing tshad ldan bzung du gzhug: ye shes lnga ldan maṇ+ḍal du: ha sa hā yis dor bar bya: rtsa ba rang la bstan pa ngan: sgrib sbyong 'bad la slar yang bskyar: bi shud+dhe yis khyor chu sbyin: rmi lam gsal phyir 'thung zhing bkru: bsrung phyir khro bo'i las sngags kyis: srung skud rdo rje'i mdud pa can: pho g.yas mo yi g.yon du gdags: dhī dang khaṃ las skyes pa yi: ku shas sngas dang stan du bya: rmi lam bzang ngan brtag pa la: ngan na sdig sgrib sbyong la 'bad: mi ldog phyir du chos bshad do: skal pa ldan pa'i slob ma rnams: rin chen maṇ+ḍal yon du dbul: 1$0000300ho: ye shes 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor du: bdag nyid bcug par mdzad nas kyang: thugs rjes lha zhal bstan pa dang: thar pa'i gnas la 'god du gsol:1$0000250

de la bla mas lan sbyin pa: 1$0000300hūm̐: gsang ba bla med dkyil 'khor du: skal pa ldan pa khyod gzhug pas: bde ba bla na med pa thob: dam tshig thams cad thub par gyis:1$0000250 slob mas dam tshig bzung ba ni: 1$0000300hūm̐: rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dpang por bzhugs: sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig rnams: srog gi phyir yang mi gtang ngo:1$0000250 bdud rtsi hūm̐ du dmigs nas kyang: 1$0000300hūm̐: 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje'i chu: bu khyod la ni sbyin par bya: dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub thob: nyams na dmyal ba chen por ltung: rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thungs shig: dam tshig thams cad thub par gyis:1$0000250 de nas slob mas bro bor ba: 1$0000300sa ma ya i dan na ra kan: 1$0000250de nas slob ma lhar bskyed la: gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ du gsal: dkyil 'khor pa yi thugs ka nas: sku gsung 1$0000250thugs kyi phyag rgya rnams:1$0000300 1$0000250char ltar babs nas lus nang khengs: gnas gsum yig 'brur thim par bsam: 1$0000300oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru de ba ḍā ki nī dzñā na ā be sha ya a āḥ1$0000250 phyag mtshan rdo rje me tog bcas: spyi bor bzhag nas brtan par bya:1$0000300 tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra:1$0000250 'brel pa brtag pa'i me tog 'bul: 1$0000300hūm̐: bskal pa gong nas 'brel pa yi: bdag gi lha mchog gang yin la: me tog bzang po 'di 'bul gyis: thugs rje'i brtse bas bzhes su gsol: puṣ+pe pra tits+tsha ho:1$0000250 gang la bab pa'i gsang mtshan gdags: me tog slar yang spyi bor bkod: 1$0000300puṣ+pe gṛh+ṇa i maṃ satwa ma hā ba la tiṣ+ṭha:1$0000250 ye shes thur mas mig dbye la: 1$0000300ho: ltos shig skal ldan rigs kyi bu: da ni dad pa rab tu skyed: ye shes dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mthong: bskal par bsags pa'i sdig sgrib 'dag: dngos grub bzang po thob nas kyang:

myur du rgyal ba'i sras su 'gyur: tsak+ṣu pra we sha ya phaṭa:1$0000250 mthong ba legs par brtan pa yis: dbang rnams bskur ba'i snod du rung: dad pa can gyi 'jug sgo 'o: sa ma ya rgya rgya: 1$0000300 sprul pa'i gter chen o rgyan mchog gyur bde chen gling pas mdo khams nam mkha' mdzod kyi lho phyogs g.yu 'bar brag nas spyan drangs pa'i shog ser glegs bam gyi ngos las/ phrin las 'gro 'dul dbang gi gnas mchog ri bo dbang zhu'i sny-ing po zla gam dbang chen phug par gtan la phab pa'i yi ge pa ni pad+ma gar dbang blo gros mtha' yas kyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/// /
